Wear the appropriate safety equipment as safety shoes, safety helmet ...etc.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work

Unit should be at shutdown mode.
Switch off all CB's on the (MCC)

items:
A work permit must be issued the maintenance staff should be qualified and 
 carry the suitable safety category
Wear the appropriate safety equipment as safety shoes, safety helmet ...etc.
Unit should be at shutdown mode.
Switch off all CB's on the (MCC)

Connect a frequency 
 source and frequency meter to the turbine magnetic speed pickup (77NH) of the 
 analog I/O modules < AIO3 > and jumper the remaining pickups in parallel to 
 the first simulate HP turbine speed to < R > < S > and < T > 
 Note :
 It may be necessary to disconnect the magnetic pickup to prevent loading down 
 the test oscillator signal

Display L12H and 
 L4Post logic signals on the CRT (Cathode Ray Tube)

Increase the frequency 
 until logic signal L12H goes to "1" the frequency should be per control syst 
 settings. Check that alarm massage "electrical over speed trip" at 
 5697+10% RPM is displayed. Check that L12H and L4Post indicate trip state in R.S.T

Adjust overspeed trip 
 constant TNKHOS if the trip setpoint is not per control syst setting, record 
 new constant TNKHOS. If it is not OK replace the hardware card and repeat the 
 step from 1-4

Manually reset L86MR1 
 and force test permissive logic L83HOST to logic "1"

Raise the governor 
 speed setpoint using the speed control raise switch until the governor reaches 
 the max limit.

If the setpoint is not 
 per control syst setting for max search speed TNKHOST readjust TNKHOST record 
 new value
